summary: Bug: Workorder -> Parts -> Margin column after it is edited it shows wrong sell price.
reported_issue: On the Work Order Parts tab, editing the Margin (%) value caused the automatically calculated Sell Price to be wrong.
expected_after_fix: Editing the Margin recalculates the Sell Price correctly (sell = cost / (1 - margin/100)).
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened work order S9-24011 Parts tab (/workorders/<id>/part-requests).
Confirmed the existing calc convention from live rows (e.g. cost 12.50 / margin 48 / sell 24.04 -> (24.04-12.50)/24.04 = 48%).
On a part request (cost=12.50, original margin=48, sell=24.04) I edited the Margin input to 50 and blurred (Tab).
Read back the recalculated Sell Price.
actual_now: After setting Margin=50 on a part with cost=12.50, the Sell Price recalculated to 25.00. Expected = 12.50/(1-0.50) = 25.00. Implied margin from the resulting sell price = 50.00%. The calculation is correct.
notes: Margin->Sell Price recalculation is accurate on current staging; the wrong-sell-price behavior does not reproduce.
